name: Jev Starter Kit: Explainer + Live Playground
description_md:
# What You Get

Everything you need to revisit the Jev walkthrough and try a decision of your own.

- 
Interactive explainer: Follow the visual walkthrough of what Jev does, how its questions work, and where it can fit into a workflow.

- 
Ask Jev playground: Bring a question, add context, choose your possible answers, and inspect the result and probabilities.

- 
Coding-assistant guide: Download a ready-to-use prompt, a hotel fine-print API example, and the essentials for building your own integration.

The live playground runs on a limited shared credit pool. Access to the sites is public; live requests depend on credits and service availability. Your own integration requires your own TypeSafe access.
